name: Soyuz T-14
about: Soyuz T-14 (1985-081A), a crewed vehicle (7K-ST), launched 1985 Sep 17. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1985 Oct 17), held fixed
docked to S13138; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
